title: US releases UFO files with eerie footage and bizarre witness accounts
description: The US government has released a trove of files related to UFO sightings, including eerie footage and bizarre witness accounts. The files, which were released under Donald Trump's administration, offer a glimpse into some of the most baffling encounters investigated by the US government. Among the released files are videos showing objects that appear to defy easy explanation, as well as testimony from military pilots, astronauts and federal officers. Officials have cautioned that unexplained does not mean extraterrestrial and that some sightings may ultimately have conventional explanations.
